name: interferon gamma-1b + interleukin-12 human recombinant
purpose: USES For the temporary relief of upper respiratory symptoms due to hay fever or airborne allergies such as: -Cough –Airway irritation –Shortness of breath
otcwarn: WARNINGS Stop use and ask doctor if symptoms of cough, shortness of breath, or wheezing do not improve, worsen or persist more than 3 days
